name: Pennylane
description: Pennylane — French accounting and finance for SMBs and their accountants: customer and supplier invoices, customers, suppliers, products, ledger entries and bank transactions. REST API v2, bearer token.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Sign in to Pennylane and open **Paramètres → Intégrations → API** (Settings → Integrations → API).
2. Create a personal access token and put it in `PENNYLANE_API_TOKEN`. The token is scoped to one company (entreprise); an accountant handling several clients needs one connector per client.

**This adapter targets API v2** at `https://app.pennylane.com/api/external/v2`. Pennylane's v1 is still served but is being wound down, and its pagination and field names differ — if you find a v1 example online, it will not work here.

**Cursor pagination.** v2 returns `next_cursor`; pass it back as `cursor` to get the following page. There is no page number, and computing an offset is not possible.

**Customer vs supplier invoices.** `customer_invoices` are what you issue; `supplier_invoices` are what you receive. Both carry `currency_amount` (in the document's currency) and `amount` (in euros), which are not the same number for a foreign-currency invoice. An invoice's lines, payments and matched transactions are not embedded in the invoice: it only links to them, so use `pennylane_list_customer_invoice_lines` for the lines.

**Filters are a JSON array**, e.g. `filter=[{"field":"date","operator":"gteq","value":"2026-01-01"}]`. Operators include `eq`, `not_eq`, `gt`, `gteq`, `lt`, `lteq`, `in`, `not_in` and `start_with`, but each field accepts only some of them: a customer or supplier `name` takes `start_with` (customers also `eq`), dates take the comparison operators. The tools below pass the string through verbatim so the full grammar stays available.

**Amounts are strings**, to avoid float rounding. Parse them; do not do arithmetic on the raw JSON in a prompt.

**Cloud reachability**: app.pennylane.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: pennylane_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their name, SIREN/SIRET, VAT number, address and payment terms. The quickest call for checking that the token works.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

filter.description: Filter JSON array, e.g. [{"field":"name","operator":"start_with","value":"Dupont"}]. Fields: name (start_with, eq), id, customer_type, ledger_account_id, external_reference, reg_no, emails (in).

tools.name: pennylane_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer by id, with their full billing address, tax identifiers, default payment conditions and recorded balance.

tools.name: pennylane_list_customer_invoices
tools.description: List invoices you issued, with their number, date, deadline, customer, currency amount and paid status — the receivables view.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with `-` for descending, e.g. -date.

tools.name: pennylane_get_customer_invoice
tools.description: Read one issued invoice: number, dates, customer, totals in the document currency and in euros, and paid status. Lines, payments and matched transactions are only linked, not embedded: use pennylane_list_customer_invoice_lines for the lines.

tools.name: pennylane_list_customer_invoice_lines
tools.description: List the lines of one issued invoice with their label, quantity, unit price, VAT rate and amounts.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

tools.name: pennylane_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices you received, with their number, date, deadline, supplier, amount and paid status — the payables view.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

filter.description: Filter JSON array over supplier-invoice fields.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with `-` for descending.

tools.name: pennylane_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their name, SIREN, VAT number and address, to resolve who a received invoice belongs to.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

filter.description: Filter JSON array over supplier fields.

tools.name: pennylane_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with their label, unit price, VAT rate and the ledger account they book to.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

tools.name: pennylane_list_ledger_entries
tools.description: List ledger entry lines with their account, label, debit, credit and journal — the bookkeeping view underneath the invoices.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

filter.description: Filter JSON array. Fields: id, journal_id, ledger_account_id, date; operators lt, lteq, gt, gteq, eq, not_eq, in, not_in.

tools.name: pennylane_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions with their date, label, amount and reconciliation state, so unpaid invoices can be matched against money that actually arrived.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

filter.description: Filter JSON array. Fields: id, bank_account_id, journal_id (eq, not_eq, in, not_in), date (eq, not_eq, gt, gteq, lt, lteq), e.g. [{"field":"date","operator":"gteq","value":"2026-09-01"}].
